Top: a part of a panorama of one pure-rotation sweep (Tamron 20\,mm lens, $f/2.8$), composed from the frames as they are and from the frames with our learned vignetting divided out; without the correction the vignetting shows as brightness steps over the windows (both panels brightened by the same factor 1.2 for display). Bottom: the first three lines of a printed page of text, from left to right the printed design (ground truth), one of the out-of-focus training photographs, the texture recovered with a pinhole camera, and the texture recovered with our aperture and focus surface; the parts are joined by hard cuts.
